title: bogota-devnet-3
announcements: **Proposed scope** for [ACDT #104](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2306). Launch is **TBD** (targeting mid-December 2026 after [ACDE #250](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2316) confirms Hegotá EL scope).

**Scope.** Focused PQ + Frames EL-only devnet while CL settles FOCIL at ACDC. Carries forward the [bogota-devnet-2](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/bogota-devnet-2) EIPs with post-devnet-2 fixes, adds native **leanSPHINCS** to EIP-8141 ([PR-12616](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12616) / [EELS#3957](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3957)) and two low-complexity cleanups (**EIP-7668**, **EIP-3298**), and swaps **EIP-4758** (Deactivate `SELFDESTRUCT`) for **EIP-8360** (`TCREATE`) so contract devs get a migration path before `SELFDESTRUCT` is deactivated. The EL activates **Bogota** at the Heze fork epoch while the CL stays on Gloas (`FRAMES_ENABLED=true`).

Frame txs are **not compatible with devnet-2**: adds `LEANSPHINCS` (`scheme=0x3`) to EIP-8141 ([PR-12616](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12616)), raises `MAX_VERIFY_GAS` to `300_000` ([PR-12644](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12644)), and statically rejects unapprovable `SENDER` frames ([PR-12656](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12656)).

eips.title: Frame Transaction: native `LEANSPHINCS` scheme ([PR-12616](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12616) / [EELS#3957](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3957)), nonce check boundary (`dc5d5fa6`), EIP-8037 share (`7372d10a`), static rejection of unapprovable `SENDER` frames ([PR-12656](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12656)), `MAX_VERIFY_GAS=300_000` ([PR-12644](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12644)), mempool ecrecover signer dependency ([PR-12670](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12670))
Keyed Nonces: single-use keyed txs pass static and mempool checks ([PR-12659](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12659))
Transaction Assertions: storage-kept nonce changes clarification (`9099f412`)
Account Code Restricted ecRecover: public mempool rules for recovered signers (`8194528a`)
Bump nonce of zero-nonce storage accounts
Remove storage-clear refund and refund cap ([EELS#3733](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3733))
